520:t_1:3.en: ～$$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader　Private Quarters～

520:t_1:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that's the truth hidden in $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

520:t_1:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「One could truly call that a god's existence.」

520:t_1:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「And protecting it is $$クロノ$$'s doctrine...」

520:t_1:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...At present, it's only my conjecture, though.」

520:t_1:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I also feel that $$ラプラスの箱$$ hides more than I've surmised.」

520:t_1:11.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Otherwise, I can't explain why $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ placed so much importance on the Box in this multiverse.」

520:t_1:13.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Yes... The truth will have to wait until we obtain the Box.」

520:t_1:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then you intend to prove your power surpasses $$クロノ$$'s and take its place...」

520:t_1:15.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you consider that servile?」

520:t_1:17.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're as harsh as ever.」

520:t_1:18.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now, our positions have reversed.」

520:t_1:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm the leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, while you could be called a prisoner. Your life and death are in my hands.」

520:t_1:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you intend to kill me, why tell me your theory about $$ラプラス$$? Surely you don't mean to call it a gift for the afterlife?」

520:t_1:21.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Perhaps I want to understand myself.」

520:t_1:23.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You risked your life to determine my true nature. Surely you can understand?」

520:t_1:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You've probably already discovered this, but originally, I was simply one of your clones.」

520:t_1:26.en:
$$シャア$$
「So others were prepared to serve as my doubles besides you...」

520:t_1:27.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But the 《$$新世時空震動$$》 changed everything.」

520:t_1:28.en:
$$シャア$$
「I believe that was when my consciousness from a parallel world flowed into you.」

520:t_1:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It sounds supernatural, but that explanation feels right to me, too.」

520:t_1:30.en:
$$シャア$$
「You know private things only I should know... And at the same time, you know a me I don't know...」

520:t_1:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's the only way to explain your knowledge of both.」

520:t_1:32.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then I'll ask you. Who are you?」

520:t_1:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you $$シャア・アズナブル$$? Or are you $$フル・フロンタル$$?」

520:t_1:35.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「What I said earlier is my answer to that.」

520:t_1:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「You want to understand yourself... So even you don't know what you are.」

520:t_1:37.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is my consciousness my own, or is it $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s...? Even I can't tell.」

520:t_1:38.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's precisely why I want to cherish the present in which I exist.」

520:t_1:39.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Continuing the present is more important than seeking an uncertain future.」

520:t_1:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「Is that why you sided with $$サイデリアル$$?」

520:t_1:41.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Surely you can understand that it's the most efficient choice for humanity.」

520:t_1:43.en:
$$シャア$$
「But it's only one option, and I will never choose it.」

520:t_1:44.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...As I thought, $$アムロ・レイ$$ and $c seem to be distorting you.」

520:t_1:45.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I believed things would go more smoothly with you, a purer $$シャア・アズナブル$$, at the forefront.」

520:t_1:46.en:
$$シャア$$
「You should have learned over these past few weeks that trying to win me over is futile.」

520:t_1:47.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Yes. Using any kind of mind control would diminish your charisma.」

520:t_1:48.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Therefore, I judge that removing the causes of your distortion is the most efficient way to welcome you as a comrade.」

520:t_1:49.en:
$$シャア$$
「You intend to eliminate $$アムロ$$ and $c?」

520:t_1:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It would be unwise to deploy $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s diminished forces.」

520:t_1:51.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But fighting isn't only a matter of force.」

520:t_1:52.en:
$$シャア$$
「I can't say I like that smile of yours.」

520:t_1:53.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Does it feel as though you're being confronted with your own unpleasant side?」

520:t_1:55.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let us go, $$シャア・アズナブル$$. For the future, the time has come to settle the ties that bind you.」

520:t_1:56.en:
$$シャア$$
(This man... may be more dangerous than I imagined...)

520:t_1:61.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...What I don't understand is what that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is thinking.」

520:t_1:62.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Has he... really become our enemy after all...?」

520:t_1:63.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What's with you, $$ヒルデ$$? Do you still believe in him?」

520:t_1:64.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「It's not that, but I just can't believe he's a bad person...」

520:t_1:65.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I understand how you feel, $$ヒルデ$$.」

520:t_1:66.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Do you feel the same way, $$セツコ$$?」

520:t_1:67.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Somewhere in my heart, I want to believe in $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, too...」

520:t_1:68.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Then couldn't you be honest about how you feel?」

520:t_1:70.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I think he's like my dad in some ways, like how he imposes his ideas on you without properly explaining them...」

520:t_1:71.en:
$$エマ$$
「Are you saying he acted that way for our sake?」

520:t_1:72.en:
$$カツ$$
「Then he's doing all that to toughen us up...!」

520:t_1:74.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I don't really understand why he'd do that, though.」

520:t_1:75.en:
$$トロワ$$
「His reason for attacking $$プラント$$ was certainly far too childish.」

520:t_1:76.en:
$$五飛$$
「He punishes anyone who doesn't obey him... His logic is like a child's.」

520:t_1:77.en:
$$デュオ$$
「So it was just some excuse to pick a fight with us...」

520:t_1:78.en:
$$カトル$$
「Even if it was, endangering the people of $$プラント$$ for that purpose is unforgivable.」

520:t_1:79.en:
$$トロワ$$
「I agree. Even if it was a prank, he went too far.」

520:t_1:80.en:
$$五飛$$
「And I don't like how he treated $n as his property.」

520:t_1:82.en:
$$フォウ$$
「He seems to have been lost in thought since the battle at $$プラント$$...」

520:t_1:84.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Are you thinking about that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ person?」

520:t_1:85.en:
$n
「I think there's no point in thinking about him.」
